lockPurpose.en: Keep your money records behind your fingerprint, face or screen lock if you turn the lock on
lockPurpose.sk: Chrániť vaše záznamy o peniazoch odtlačkom prsta, tvárou alebo zámkou obrazovky, ak zámku zapnete

notifyPurpose.en: Warn you when a budget is nearly used up and remind you about recurring payments
notifyPurpose.sk: Upozorniť vás, keď je rozpočet takmer vyčerpaný, a pripomínať pravidelné platby

filesPurpose.en: Save your entries as a CSV file, or add entries from one
filesPurpose.sk: Uložiť záznamy ako súbor CSV alebo z neho záznamy pridať

widgetPurpose.en: Show what is safe to spend today and this month’s spending on your home screen
widgetPurpose.sk: Zobraziť na ploche, koľko môžete dnes minúť, a tohtomesačné výdavky

cameraPurpose.en: Take a photo of a receipt to keep with the entry
cameraPurpose.sk: Odfotiť bloček a uložiť ho k záznamu

pickPurpose.en: Pick a picture of a receipt from your photos to keep with the entry
pickPurpose.sk: Vybrať obrázok bločku z vašich fotiek a uložiť ho k záznamu

filesFlow.en: Your entries, saved as a CSV file in a place you choose
filesFlow.sk: Vaše záznamy sa uložia ako súbor CSV na miesto, ktoré vyberiete

tellMeWhenRecurring.en: Tell me when a recurring expense is added
tellMeWhenRecurring.sk: Oznámiť, keď sa pridá pravidelný výdavok

addItNowIt.en: Add it now, it takes a few seconds.
addItNowIt.sk: Zapíšte to hneď, zaberie to pár sekúnd.

addedBody.en: {amount}, as planned. Tap to check it.
addedBody.sk: {amount} podľa plánu. Klepnutím si ho pozriete.

dueBodyEntry.en: {amount} on {date}. Add it to your entries?

exportedEntries.en: {n, plural, =0 {Saved an empty file.} one {Saved # entry.} other {Saved # entries.}}
exportedEntries.sk: {n, plural, =0 {Uložil sa prázdny súbor.} one {Uložený # záznam.} few {Uložené # záznamy.} many {Uložené # záznamu.} other {Uložených # záznamov.}}

safeSetBudget.en: Set a monthly budget in the app
safeSetBudget.sk: Nastavte si v aplikácii mesačný rozpočet

nExpenses.en: {n, plural, =0 {No expenses} one {# expense} other {# expenses}}
nExpenses.sk: {n, plural, =0 {Žiadne výdavky} one {# výdavok} few {# výdavky} many {# výdavku} other {# výdavkov}}

ownSpent.label: @spentThisMonth2
ownSpent.compute: =coalesce(sum(item.expenses.filter(e, e.kind == 'expense' && e.date >= startOf(today(), 'month') && e.date <= endOf(today(), 'month')).map(e, coalesce(e.baseAmount, e.amount))), decimal('0'))

budgetPct.label: @budgetShare
budgetPct.compute: =coalesce(item.category.budget, decimal('0')) > 0 ? coalesce(item.baseAmount, item.amount) * 100 / coalesce(item.category.budget, decimal('1')) : decimal('0')

parentPct.label: @parentShare
parentPct.compute: =coalesce(item.category.parent.budget, decimal('0')) > 0 ? coalesce(item.baseAmount, item.amount) * 100 / coalesce(item.category.parent.budget, decimal('1')) : decimal('0')

spentOtherDays.where: =item.kind == 'expense' && item.date >= startOf(today(), 'month') && item.date <= endOf(today(), 'month') && item.date != today()

openHalves.where: =item.srcHalf == true && item.kind == 'transfer' && item.account != null && item.toAccount == null

halfIn.where: =item.srcHalf == true && item.kind == 'transfer' && item.account == null && item.toAccount != null && item.date == args.date && item.amount == args.amount && string(item.toAccount) != args.from

values.rate: =args.rule.currency == null || args.rule.currency == first(q.prefsAll).currency || size(vars.rate) == 0 ? null : first(vars.rate).perMain
values.baseAmount: =args.rule.currency == null || args.rule.currency == first(q.prefsAll).currency ? args.rule.amount : (size(vars.rate) > 0 ? round(coalesce(args.rule.amount, decimal('0')) * coalesce(first(vars.rate).perMain, decimal('1')), 2) : args.rule.amount)

args.title: =args.category.spentMonth > coalesce(args.category.budget, decimal('0')) ? t('overTitle', {'name': args.category.name}) : t('nearTitle', {'name': args.category.name})

set.kind: =args.row.srcTransfer == true || args.row.srcType == 'transfer' || args.row.srcType == 'transferIn' || args.row.srcType == 'transferOut' || startsWith(coalesce(args.row.category.name, ''), "To '") || startsWith(coalesce(args.row.category.name, ''), "From '") ? 'transfer' : (args.row.srcType == 'income' || (args.row.srcType != 'expense' && (args.row.srcIncome == true || coalesce(args.row.srcIncomeAmount, decimal('0')) > 0 || (args.row.srcType == null && args.row.srcIncome == null && args.row.srcIncomeAmount == null && args.row.account != null && coalesce(args.row.srcSigned, decimal('0')) > 0))) ? 'income' : 'expense')

set.account: =args.row.kind == 'transfer' && args.row.toAccount == null && (args.row.srcType == 'transferIn' || args.row.srcType == 'income' || startsWith(coalesce(args.row.category.name, ''), "From '") || (args.row.srcType != 'expense' && args.row.srcType != 'transferOut' && coalesce(args.row.srcSigned, decimal('0')) > 0)) ? null : args.row.account
set.toAccount: =args.row.kind == 'transfer' && args.row.toAccount == null && (args.row.srcType == 'transferIn' || args.row.srcType == 'income' || startsWith(coalesce(args.row.category.name, ''), "From '") || (args.row.srcType != 'expense' && args.row.srcType != 'transferOut' && coalesce(args.row.srcSigned, decimal('0')) > 0)) ? args.row.account : args.row.toAccount

steps.where: =item.createdAt >= args.since && item.createdAt <= args.until && size(item.expenses) == 0 && size(item.children) == 0 && size(item.recurring) == 0

budgetCrossed.when: =item.srcNew != true && coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).budgetAlerts, true) && item.kind == 'expense' && item.date >= startOf(today(), 'month') && item.date <= endOf(today(), 'month') && item.budgetPct > 0 && ((coalesce(item.category.usedPct, decimal('0')) >= coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).warnAt, 80) && coalesce(item.category.usedPct, decimal('0')) - item.budgetPct < coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).warnAt, 80)) || (coalesce(item.category.usedPct, decimal('0')) > 100 && coalesce(item.category.usedPct, decimal('0')) - item.budgetPct <= 100))

parentCrossed.when: =item.srcNew != true && coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).budgetAlerts, true) && item.kind == 'expense' && item.date >= startOf(today(), 'month') && item.date <= endOf(today(), 'month') && item.parentPct > 0 && ((coalesce(item.category.parent.usedPct, decimal('0')) >= coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).warnAt, 80) && coalesce(item.category.parent.usedPct, decimal('0')) - item.parentPct < coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).warnAt, 80)) || (coalesce(item.category.parent.usedPct, decimal('0')) > 100 && coalesce(item.category.parent.usedPct, decimal('0')) - item.parentPct <= 100))

totalCrossed.when: =item.srcNew != true && coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).budgetAlerts, true) && item.kind == 'expense' && item.date >= startOf(today(), 'month') && item.date <= endOf(today(), 'month') && coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) > 0 && ((coalesce(q.monthSpent.total, decimal('0')) * 100 >= coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) * coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).warnAt, 80) && (coalesce(q.monthSpent.total, decimal('0')) - coalesce(item.baseAmount, item.amount)) * 100 < coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) * coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).warnAt, 80)) || (coalesce(q.monthSpent.total, decimal('0')) > coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) && coalesce(q.monthSpent.total, decimal('0')) - coalesce(item.baseAmount, item.amount) <= coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, decimal('0'))))

safeWidget.title: @safeToday
safeWidget.value: =coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, q.topBudgets.total, decimal('0')) <= 0 ? t('safeNone') : formatCurrency(max(round((coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, q.topBudgets.total, decimal('0')) - coalesce(q.spentOtherDays.total, decimal('0'))) / (daysBetween(today(), endOf(today(), 'month')) + 1), 2), decimal('0')), coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).currency, 'EUR'))
safeWidget.caption: =coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, q.topBudgets.total, decimal('0')) <= 0 ? t('safeSetBudget') : (coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, q.topBudgets.total, decimal('0')) >= coalesce(q.monthSpent.total, decimal('0')) ? t('safeLeft', {'today': formatCurrency(coalesce(q.spentToday.total, decimal('0')), coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).currency, 'EUR')), 'left': formatCurrency(coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, q.topBudgets.total, decimal('0')) - coalesce(q.monthSpent.total, decimal('0')), coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).currency, 'EUR'))}) : t('safeOver', {'over': formatCurrency(coalesce(q.monthSpent.total, decimal('0')) - coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).monthlyBudget, q.topBudgets.total, decimal('0')), coalesce(first(q.prefsAll).currency, 'EUR'))}))
